note: Small family-run campground in the hills between Bristol and Lincoln, with wooded sites along Shadow Brook and open field sites. The operator describes the sites as primarily for tent camping, with a few RV sites: give the rig length when booking. The operator advises against Lincoln Gap and Roxbury Gap roads; come in by Route 17 or 125. --Claude
summary: Operator site live (rates page updated 2026-05-15): $35 / $40 with 20-A electric, 15 sites, hot showers, phone/email booking, May 15-Oct 15. Price passes. Google 4.6 (21) + website + phone = presence. Not seasonal (no units parked on early-May 2024 imagery). CRITERIA flag: 'The sites are primarily for tent camping, with a few sites that include limited electrical hook up'; no RV length stated. Not waterfront kept. Phone/website unchanged.
flags: CRITERIA (rig fit unclear): operator home page: 'The sites are primarily for tent camping, with a few sites that include limited electrical hook up of up to [20 amps]'. FAQ: 'if you are looking for an RV site please specify the length and electricity requirements' - RVs are taken, but no length is stated anywhere and no Google review read mentions an RV (reviews quoted: tent camper after backcountry trip; a motorcycle camper 'whether a wooded or field site'). Keep with the caveat now in the note (AWH 2026-11-02 unclear-fit rule), or drop if a mostly-tent 15-site park is out.

Google 4.6 (21 reviews; under 25, so presence rests on the live website + phone 802-453-3687, both present). RV Life 4* (stored). WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept): 'Most wooded sites have access to Shadow Brook, a small brook' - a small brook under woods with no named sites; at most creekside, unearned. Stays down.
